events.title: Combat Streaks, Balance & UI Polish
events.summary: Gameplay & Balance Revamped Multiplier Streak System: I completely overhauled the scoring streak mechanic to reward aggressive and skilled play over passive strategies. No-Damage Streak: Gain a +0.01x multiplier for every 5 enemies defeated without taking damage.Dodge Bonus: Instantly gain a +0.25x multiplier for 5 seconds when successfully dodging enemy attacks.Kill Chain: Every 8 enemies defeated within an 8-second window adds a +0.02x multiplier. events.title: Survival & Capture Nodes
events.summary: New Survival Node:Face an endless onslaught! Instead of regular enemy waves, a single enemy type will continuously swarm the arena for a set duration (e.g., 120 seconds). Note: Enemies here drop only Gold, no XP. If you survive the timer, you will be rewarded with a massive level-up bonus featuring stat cards with 4x the usual attributes!New Capture Node:A tactical new arena featuring a swarm of a single enemy type and designated capture zones. events.title: Chako Demo is Now Live!
events.summary: Hello everyone!The day has finally arrived—the Chako Demo is now officially live and ready to play!What's in the Demo?This demo gives you a solid taste of the core loop, covering exactly the first third of the full game. While the final release will feature Green, Red, and Purple thematic zones across 19 map nodes, this demo grants you full access to the Green Theme, allowing you to explore and conquer the first 7 nodes.
